text: Toyota Motor Corporation is Tokyo- and NYSE-listed. Per its FY2026 Form 20-F, Toyota states it 'is not owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by another corporation, any foreign government or any natural or legal person'; its only disclosed 5%+ holder, Toyota Industries Corporation (9.17% as of 31 March 2026), tendered nearly all of that stake into Toyota's own share buyback, falling to 0.1% by the tender's May 2026 settlement.

source.name: Toyota Motor Corporation Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: To the extent known to Toyota, Toyota is not owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by another corporation, any foreign government or any natural or legal person
